method.description: Archive-only materialization followed by first-hand structural measurement. The adopted Edition 1.2 archive was verified by size and SHA-256 before it was opened. The single pinned entry was extracted, verified against the exact source contract on byte count and SHA-256 before installation, installed into the sealed external materialization root, then re-read from its installed path and re-verified on byte count, SHA-256 and file signature. The installed file was measured with the committed factory PDF inspector, and the terminal-field count was independently reproduced by a second loader.
method.privateCorpusUsedNote: The private corpus was not opened, read or consulted. The assignment forbids copying from it and the archive supplied the bytes.

theDenominatorRule.instruction: A field or ownership map must key on the terminal field names recorded here, never on a bare count.
theDenominatorRule.whyTheyDiffer: Six terminal fields carry more than one widget annotation: ∆ (2), Case Number (2), Group_4A (3), Group_Event (2), Group_Interp (2) and GroupCoS (3). 51 + 8 additional widgets = 59. A map built against 59 would invent eight fields that do not exist; a renderer that writes 51 values must still paint 59 annotations.

structuralMeasurement.signatureFieldNote: No PDF signature field. Sig, Sig_Aty and Sig_Date are ordinary text fields for a wet or typed signature, not digital signature widgets.
structuralMeasurement.javaScriptNote: No document-level or field-level JavaScript was reported by the inspector.

exportValueHazard.instruction: Select radio states by the exact export value read from this inventory, per widget, and verify the resulting appearance state. Do not normalise #20 to a space before writing.
